title: Frontend: Loop A to Z
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Loop A to Z. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution({from,to}). Return an array of uppercase ASCII letters from from through to inclusive. Default A through Z. Reject non-single-uppercase endpoints or reversed ranges with Invalid range.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Iterate over the integer code points from A through Z and convert each with String.fromCharCode or String.fromCodePoint.
alternativeApproaches: Parameterize the range and reject surrogate or invalid Unicode code points deliberately.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: First/last letter; exactly 26 entries; no lowercase.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
